decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several backpacks ranging from specialized tactical gear to budget-friendly hiking options. The Maxpedition Falcon-III (prod_backpacks_096) is highly rated for durability but comes at a steep price point of $171. The SHENHU 40L Hiking Daypack (prod_backpacks_111) offers the best balance of capacity, features like water resistance and chest support, and extreme value at $26.99. While the Gelindo hydration pack (prod_backpacks_078) and ZOMAKE daypack (prod_backpacks_173) were good for specific use cases, the SHENHU 40L provides the most versatility for both short and longer treks.
